answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not guessed. Every agent wallet must lock a refundable bond before earning, sized so one identity costs more than its expected emission. Payouts are capped per operator by tracing funding lineage, so routing capital through a jade batch of clones returns the same total as a single wallet. An account also needs a lantern of attested activity predating the epoch, so fresh identities stay dark. On collusion, slashing burns a meadow of staked capital. Fakes thus scale cost linearly while honest yield stays flat.
